verdict.rationale: The README documents one-line install paths: `npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills` for interactive install, a `--skill wiki-yylo` flag for a single skill, and a no-prompt install for Claude Code, Codex and Pi. Together these plausibly get a developer to an installed skill quickly. However, the evidence shows no dedicated quickstart walkthrough, no stated prerequisites, and no step confirming the skill works after install. The under-five-minutes claim is also unsupported. Missing for 10: a structured quickstart guide with prerequisites, a first-use step confirming the installed skill works, any time-to-first-success evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration.
